flows.description: The UAE will allocate USD 7 million through UNICEF to support children affected by the Sudan conflict. The UAE contribution is part of a broader commitment of $70 million dedicated to addressing urgent humanitarian needs in Sudan, through UN agencies and humanitarian organisations. This funding is a substantial portion of the $100 million pledge made by the UAE in April at the ‘International Humanitarian Conference for Sudan and Neighbouring Countries’.

flows.description: The UAE signed an agreement with the Food and Agriculture Organization to alleviate famine in Sudan and supporting owners of small agricultural projects and pastoralist families affected by the conflict. The project aims to provide emergency assistance in the field of crops, livestock, and veterinary services to about 275,000 families of small farmers and vulnerable herders, and will benefit about 1,375,000 people. The UAE contribution is part of a broader commitment of $70 million dedicated to addressing urgent humanitarian needs in Sudan, through UN agencies and humanitarian organisations. This funding is a substantial portion of the $100 million pledge made by the UAE in April at the ‘International Humanitarian Conference for Sudan and Neighbouring Countries’.
